note: Merced Irrigation District campground on the point above Lake McClure near New Exchequer Dam; about half the sites have water and electric. Boat launch, swim lagoon and fish-cleaning station. --Claude
summary: Operator page + fee schedule + Campspot booking site + 2017 site map + imagery/3DEP read. $38 basic / $48 30A / $65 50A, $3 off military/disabled/senior, $12 second vehicle, 8 people max; 100 sites (52 W/E), showers; open; Campspot booking at book.lakemcclure.com. WATERFRONT: lakefront -> lakeview recommended (closest F-loop road 12-21 m from full pool but 6-9 m above it on a ~20-25 degree slope; fails the kayak test). Website moved (301). Phone OK.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN recommended (lakefront -> lakeview): the closest sites are the F-loop electric sites on the hairpin around the point (operator map F 1-12, all water/electric, sold by the night; the map is a 2017 drawing, so which side is which is approximate - F 9-12 face the north-ramp arm, F 3-8 the main lake). 3DEP + Esri: the road there (~37.6118,-120.2754 N side, ~37.6111,-120.2760 W side, ~37.6108,-120.2742 E side) sits 12-21 m from the 264 m (867 ft) full-pool contour, which matches the brown-grass/pale-drawdown boundary on the imagery, but at 270-273 m: 6-9 m above full pool on a ~20-25 degree grass slope with scattered oaks. Distance passes; height does not (the kayak test passes 1-2 m over a gentle bank and calls a 2-3.7 m bank at ~30 degrees a view). The A-loop area by the south arm is ~60 m from the high-water line. The stored evidence ('within ~15-30 m of the vegetated high-water line') measured distance only. Suggested evidence: 'Operator map 2017 + Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-27: F-loop sites on the point road 12-21 m from the 867-ft full-pool line but 6-9 m above it on a 20-25 degree slope (fails the kayak test); A loop ~60 m back -> lakeview.'
STATUS: 'All Campgrounds and Cabins - OPEN'; McClure Point North launch ramp closed (alert), swim lagoon closed. Season not posted (left unset).
HOOKUPS: the 2017 map marks ~42 sites red (water/electric) against the page's 52; 52 kept. Sewer never mentioned ('Water-electric hookup sites'); stored sewer false left as is.
